judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements the usage accumulation logic and covers all required behavioral scenarios with thorough unit and acceptance tests. However, it misses the fourth acceptance criterion—making the hook's public signature unambiguous (which the candidate's own unchecked `.lore/dod.md` facet also admits)—leaving `usage?: UsageMetadata` untouched on `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` whereas the reference renames the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` across code and docs. Additionally, the candidate leaves the `.lore/dod.md` scratch artifact in the diff and adds a standalone acceptance test file rather than placing the new tests alongside the existing tool-loop tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of promoting it to the main specification list as the reference did.
